text: DEFONEOS — MOD Defence Medical AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Article 50 DEFONEOS × MOD × DEFENCE MEDICAL MOD Defence Medical AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK defence medical services — Defence Medical Services (DMS), DMICP, operational medical planning, combat casualty care, veteran health transition, and military mental health. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 5 Backbone Orgs 🏛️ 12 Entry Points EHR Defence Medical Information Capability Programme (DMICP) Military electronic health record system. 200K+ serving personnel records. Deployed medical documentation. Theatre healthcare records. Continuity of care from operations to NHS. Single integrated patient record across all services. Casualty Combat Casualty Care & CASEVAC Battlefield trauma management. Tactical Combat Casualty Care (TCCC) protocols. Aeromedical evacuation chain. Damage control surgery. Role 1/2/3/4 medical facility integration. Golden hour optimisation. Mental Health Department of Community Mental Health (DCMH) Military mental health services. PTSD screening and treatment. Operational stress management. Combat stress reaction. Transition mental health support. 45,000+ mental health contacts annually across all services. Veterans Veterans UK & Armed Forces Compensation Armed Forces Compensation Scheme (AFCS). War Pension Scheme. Injury and illness attribution. Medical discharge assessment. Veterans' mental health (NHS Op COURAGE). 100K+ compensation claims managed. Occupational Military Occupational Health & Fitness Medical employment standards. Fitness for role assessment. Noise and vibration exposure monitoring. Hazardous substance surveillance. Aviation and diving medicals. 150K+ fitness assessments annually. Deployed Operational Medical Planning & Force Health Protection Pre-deployment medical screening. Theatre entry standards. Vaccination and chemoprophylaxis. Environmental threat assessment. Heat/cold injury prevention. 30,000+ deployment medical assessments annually. Dental Defence Dental Services (DDS) Military dental readiness. Deployability dental standards. Dental fitness classification. Operational dental capability. Restorative treatment planning. 200K+ dental contacts annually. Rehabilitation Defence Medical Rehabilitation Centre (DMRC) Headley Court & Stanford Hall Complex trauma rehabilitation. Prosthetics and orthotics. Adaptive sport. Vocational retraining. Psychological rehabilitation. Multi-disciplinary team coordination. 1,200+ rehabilitation episodes annually. Research Defence Science & Technology Laboratory (Dstl) Biomedical Military biomedical research. Blast injury research. Chemical/biological medical countermeasures. Operational medicine evidence synthesis. Clinical trial governance. £50M+ annual defence medical research. NHS Interface NHS Armed Forces Covenant & Transition NHS priority treatment for service-attributable conditions. GP registration continuity. Hospital treatment pathway. Mental health service handover. Op COURAGE veteran mental health. 25K+ annual service-NHS transitions. Pharmacy Defence Primary Healthcare & Pharmacy Military GP services. 160+ medical centres worldwide. Prescribing governance. Controlled drug management. Field pharmacy capability. Medicines optimisation across global postings. Parliamentary Defence Select Committee Medical DMS performance scrutiny. Military mental health accountability. Veterans' care standards. Rehabilitation effectiveness. Armed Forces Covenant compliance. Defence medical procurement oversight. ⚡ 8 Transformation Priorities 1. DMICP Intelligence & Continuity AI-powered clinical decision support within DMICP. Deployed-to-NHS record continuity. Predictive health risk scoring. Medication interaction checking. Theatre clinical documentation automation. 200K+ records governed. 2. Combat Casualty Care AI TCCC protocol decision suppo
